title: The mailbox in snow
logline: Snow, rarer than 2025's, on the mailbox, the flag down, the road white, one set of tire tracks. The page's whole winter in one box.

panels.composition: A roadside mailbox capped with snow, flag down, a white road with a single set of tire tracks, a porch light far back.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a roadside mailbox capped with snow with its flag down, a white road with a single set of tire tracks and a distant porch light, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
